question: Where is Brahma located in the Maṇḍūka and higher diagrams?
premises: Brahma is situated in the middle.
This placement is declared for the Maṇḍūka diagram.
The same placement applies to the higher diagram.
inference: Brahma occupies the central position in both the Maṇḍūka and the subsequent higher diagram.
uncertainties: The exact identity of tatpare is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Brahma is declared to be situated in the middle, in the Maṇḍūka diagram and also in the higher one.
